description:
This protocol performs the Lexogen QuantSeq 3'mRNA FWD NGS library prep for up to 96 samples.



NEST 0.1mL 96-well PCR plates, full skirt
Opentrons 4-in-1 tuberack set with 4x6 insert holding NEST 1.5mL microcentrifuge tubes
Opentrons magnetic module
Opentrons temperature module with 4x6 aluminum block holding NEST 1.5mL microcentrifuge tubes
Opentrons P20 GEN2 single-channel electronic pipette
Opentrons P300 multi-channel electronic pipette
Opentrons 10/20µl tipracks
Opentrons 50/300µl tipracks



4x6 tuberack (slot 2):
 tube A1: RS
 tube A2: SS1
* tube A3: SS2
4x6 aluminum block on temperature module (slot 7):
 tube A1: FS1
 tube A2: FS2/E1
 tube A3: PB
 tube A4: EB
 tube A5: PS
 tube A6: PCR/E3

labware.name: reagent tuberack with 1.5ml snapcap tubes on 2
NEST 96 Well Plate 100 µL PCR Full Skirt on Magnetic Module GEN1 on 4
Opentrons 24 Well Aluminum Block with NEST 1.5 mL Snapcap on Temperature Module GEN1 on 7
